question.text: A portfolio has β = 1.2. Rf = 6%, Rm = 12%. CAPM required return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Required R = 6 + 1.2 × (12 - 6) = 6 + 7.2 = 13.2%. The Trap: 14.4% uses wrong premium; 18% is sum; 12% is Rm. Cross-Exam Context: CAPM classic. Manager's Pro-Tip: If actual return exceeds CAPM required by a material margin, the PM has generated 'Jensen's alpha'.
